scenes.setting: Deeper in: the Specter Portrait Frame bagged in black cloth by an archbishop who turns out to be an alchemical doll — rusted gears and springs dropping off him as the aging path to the dais strips him — past corpses withered to ninety years old, to an empty coffin cushioned with a twelve-ringed worm, and the upturned portrait he lifts: a smiling young man in a pointed hat with a crystal monocle. Amon
